title: 第4章 下山

content_zh:
展步急忙点点头：“师傅教训的是。”
“你小子还想开门立派，搞什么相胸术，可是胸能看出什么？你要是能达到望气的境界也就罢了，现在不过是观型，就算看个大概，有什么用？还是老老实实……”
展步知道，老道又想拐弯抹角的让自己放弃相胸这一伟大的事业，不过展步肯定不会吃这一套，他的头摇得像个波浪：“师傅，您就先说为什么不收她卦金，我现在是没您的道行，但是，我要是有您这么大岁数，那这女人屁股上有几根毛我一看胸就能知道。”
听到展步的话老道一愣，然后怒道：“再胡言乱语，信不信老道我现在就把你屁股“嘻嘻，不敢了不敢了，师傅，究竟是怎么回事？”展步急忙问道。
老道捻了一下胡须：“嘿嘿，教你个乖乖，那算计她的人，是她二十年前抛弃的亲生儿子，咱们收卦金，要么一开始压好了卦金，说一是一，说二是二，要么事情解决了之后收卦金，切不可虎头蛇尾，否则就是有损德修。”
听到老道这一句话，展步点了点头，他们这一脉相师，可不是简单的透露一下天机，而是真的能帮上人家的忙，能解决人家的难处，就像医生一样，不把人治好了，怎么好意思收钱？
展步接着嬉皮笑脸的问道：“师傅，那您说，您会收她多少钱润金啊？”
老道咪咪一笑：“傻小子，这女人是大户，对这种人，你就不能谈钱，那多俗，你不要，她自己就会心诚意善的来孝敬，而且绝对不是小数。”
展步依旧不死心的问道：“那师傅说，下次啦，她会带多少孝敬您？”
道伸出一个攥紧的拳头在展步面前得意的晃了晃。
展步吞了一口口水：“您是说，不少于十万？”
老道悠然一笑：“怎么，吓到了？以后等你相术有师傅这水平，这个数还是小的。”
展步知道，老道从来不在这上面吹牛皮，他说十万，那就至少是十万，对这个，老道看的非常准。
展步此时又把脸凑到了老道面前，一脸讨好。
“干什么？想要零花钱？师傅我现在也没钱。”老道不耐烦的说道。
展步嘿嘿一笑：“不不不，不是要零花钱，师傅，我就是想问问，今天一天没看到胖师兄，师兄哪里去了？”
这山上如今就生活着三个人，一个是老道，然后就是俩徒弟，胖师兄和展步，大部分情况下，师兄弟下山都是老道带着，但是今天却一整天没见到胖师兄。
“下山买火车票去了。”老道说道。
“火车票？”展步疑惑：“难道又要出远门了？”
“不是出远门，是你要下山了。”老道说道。

展步一愣，没明白老道的意思：“我要下山？”
老道点了点头：“不错，老道我掐指一算，咱们师徒俩的师徒情分也就这十八年，这是天意，你我师徒情分的确已经尽了，再强留你在山上，只怕要多出祸端……”
展步也知道，老道虽然平时跳脱，但是一旦做出了决定，就绝不会更改，他对老道拜了拜：“师傅，有空我会回来看您的。”
老道的目光变的慈爱，他细心的叮嘱：“哎，你这孩子，命里多桃花，这既是福，也是祸，人说色字头上一把刀，你下山之后要好自为之，不要仗着自己的本事为所欲为，切不可做那薄幸寡义之辈，否则的话，老道绝不饶你。”
展步点了点头：“放心吧师傅，徒弟的人品您还信不过吗。”
老道点了点头，就不再言语，很多话，涉及到“天机”，不能随意道破，否则就会受到冥冥中的处罚，老道对这个非常谨慎。
吱呀一声，大门被推开，是胖师兄回来了。
“师傅，车票买回来了。”
胖师兄进门之后给老道行了个礼。
原本老道一共收了七个徒弟，胖师兄是老大，名为庞铎。展步是老小，另外几个师兄早就学有所成，下山去了，如今，自己也要离开，只剩下了大师兄还留在山上。
说起大师兄，展步也有些哭笑不得，老道的七个徒弟，每一个人下山之后都是学了一身本事，出去之后一个个如龙游大海，鹰翔长空，但是唯独胖师兄是个例外。
他跟随师傅时间最长，最受师傅器重，可是什么奇门遁甲，风水相术，胖师兄是一概都没学会。除了练了一身硬功夫之外，别无所长。
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢桃运大相师请大家
content_en:
Zhan Bu nodded hurriedly: "Master taught me a lesson."
"You guys still want to open up a sect and do some chest physiognomy, but what can be seen on the chest? It's only if you can reach the state of looking at qi. Now it's just a look at the shape. Even if you have a rough look, what's the use? Just stay honest..."
Zhan Bu knew that the old Taoist wanted to make him give up the great cause of having breasts in a roundabout way, but Zhan Bu would definitely not take this trick. He shook his head like a wave: "Master, please tell me first why you don't accept her fortune. I don't have your Taoism now, but if I were as old as you, I would know how many hairs this woman has on her buttocks just by looking at her breasts."
Hearing Zhan Bu's words, the old man was stunned, and then said angrily: "If you keep talking nonsense, believe it or not, I will kick your butt right now." Hehe, I don't dare anymore, master, what's going on? Zhan Bu asked hurriedly.
The old man twirled his beard and said, "Hey, I'll teach you to be a good boy. The person who plotted against her is the biological son she abandoned twenty years ago. Let's collect the hexagram gold. Either press the hexagram gold at the beginning and say one is one and two is two. Or collect the hexagram gold after the matter is resolved. Don't start in an anticlimactic manner, otherwise it will be detrimental to moral cultivation. "
Hearing what Lao Dao said, Zhan Bu nodded. Their pulse masters are not simply revealing secrets, but can really help others and solve their problems. Just like doctors, if they don't cure people, how can they be embarrassed to accept money?
Zhan Bu then asked with a playful smile: "Master, tell me, how much money will you charge her? "
The old Taoist smiled and said: "Silly boy, this woman is a wealthy person. You can't talk about money with such a person. It's so vulgar. If you don't want it, she will show her filial piety sincerely and kindly, and it will definitely not be a small number. "
Zhan Bu still refused to give up and asked: "Master said, next time, how much will she bring to honor you? "
Dao stretched out a clenched fist and shook it proudly in front of Zhan Bu.
Zhan Bu swallowed a mouthful of saliva: "You mean, no less than 100,000? "
The old Taoist smiled leisurely: "Why, are you scared? In the future, when your physiognomy reaches the level of a master, this number will still be small. "
Zhan Bu knows that Lao Tao never brags about this. If he says one hundred thousand, it must be at least one hundred thousand. Lao Tao is very accurate about this.
At this time, Zhan Bu put his face in front of the old Tao again, with a flattering look on his face.
"What? Want pocket money? Master, I don’t have any money now either. "The old Taoist said impatiently.
Zhan Bu chuckled: "No, no, no, I'm not asking for pocket money, master. I just want to ask, if I haven't seen my fat senior brother today, where did he go?" "
There are three people living on this mountain now, one is the old Taoist, and then there are two apprentices, Fatty Senior Brother and Zhan Bu. In most cases, the old Taoist takes the senior brothers down the mountain, but today I didn't see Fatty Senior Brother all day.
"I went down the mountain to buy a train ticket. "The old Taoist said.
"Train ticket? Zhan Bu was confused: "Are you going to travel far away again?" "
"It's not that you're going far away, it's that you're going down the mountain. "The old Taoist said.
Zhan Bu was stunned for a moment, not understanding what Lao Dao meant: "I want to go down the mountain? "
The old Taoist nodded: "Yes, old Taoist, let me make a calculation. The master-disciple relationship between us is only eighteen years. This is God's will. The master-disciple relationship between you and me has indeed been exhausted. If I keep you on the mountain forcibly, I'm afraid there will be more trouble..."
Zhan Bu also knew that although the old Taoist usually made a decision, he would never change it once he made a decision. He bowed to the old Taoist: "Master, I will come back to see you when I have time. "
The old Taoist's eyes became kind, and he warned carefully: "Hey, you kid, you have many peach blossoms in your life. This is both a blessing and a curse. People say that sex is like a knife in your head. After you come down from the mountain, you should take care of yourself. Don't rely on your own abilities to do whatever you want. Don't be that unlucky and unjust person. Otherwise, the old Taoist will never spare you." "
Zhan Bu nodded: "Don't worry, master, don't you still believe in your apprentice's character? "
The old Taoist nodded and stopped talking. Many words involved "heavenly secrets" and could not be revealed at will, otherwise he would be punished secretly. The old Taoist was very cautious about this.
With a creak, the door was pushed open, and it was the fat senior brother who came back.
"Master, I bought the ticket. "
After the fat senior brother entered the door, he saluted the old man.
Originally, the old Taoist had a total of seven apprentices, and the fat senior brother was the eldest, named Pang Duo. Zhan Bu is the youngest. The other senior brothers have already accomplished their studies and have gone down the mountain. Now, he has to leave too. Only the senior brother is left on the mountain.
Speaking of Senior Brother, Zhan Bu was also a little bit dumbfounded. Each of the seven experienced apprentices learned a skill after coming down from the mountain. After they went out, they were like dragons swimming in the sea and eagles soaring in the sky, but Fat Senior Brother was the exception.
He has been with his master for the longest time and is the most respected by him, but Senior Brother Fat has never learned anything about Qi Men Dun Jia or Feng Shui Physiognomy. Apart from practicing hard kung fu, he has no other talents.
